pr_title: Expand env-vars in background image path
pr_body:
## Summary of the Pull Request
Expands any environment variables in background image file paths so that users can specify location of background images relative to, for example, %USERPROFILE%

## References
* Terminal takes an unexpected dirt nap when backgroundImage contains environment variables #2922 

## PR Checklist
* [X] Closes #2922
* [X] CLA signed. If not, go over [here](https://cla.opensource.microsoft.com/microsoft/Terminal) and sign the CLA
* [X] Tests added/passed
* [ ] Requires documentation to be updated
* [X] I've discussed this with core contributors already. If not checked, I'm ready to accept this work might be rejected in favor of a different grand plan. Issue number where discussion took place: #xxx

## Validation Steps Performed
Thoroughly debugged with previous failing case, now working case, empty strings, etc. Also added basic regression tests that will fail if icon or backgroundImage paths contain env-vars and the path expansion mechanisms are ever removed/subverted.
pr_comments: You should force push this PR instead of deleting it and making a new one! You can even just revert your readme changes in this branch.

issue_context.title: Terminal takes an unexpected dirt nap when backgroundImage contains environment variables
issue_context.body: I literally can't believe we're not expanding environment variables.
comments:
@DHowett-MSFT I'm confused. #1468 (environment variables in icon) was fixed in version 0.3.x but the `backgroundImage` setting (and all other settings using a path) were not? I can't believe it :) 

Actually, I wanted to file a new issue because Version `0.6.2951.0` crashes when I use `"backgroundImage": "%userprofile%\\etc"`. Specifying the full path works fine. Now I found this issue, it has been closed only 5 days ago... I suppose, its not released, yet?

> this issue, it has been closed only 5 days ago... I suppose, its not released, yet?

That's correct - we should be releasing another update later this month that will contain this fix.

:tada:This issue was addressed in #3204, which has now been successfully released as `Windows Terminal Preview v0.7.3291.0`.:tada:
